legs.trained: a bare Go2's velocity tracking, 12 leg actions (decoupled.WALKERS)
legs.observation: flat_env_cfg's 235 (velocities, gravity, command, legs, last action, height scan; no noise), plus the gait clock for p2dingo_gait

arm.control: IK on Link6 + jaw centre in the base's current frame (decoupled_arm.py), grasp pitch/roll from the scripted grip's order, held per attempt
arm.model: D1 firmware planner (F-045) into the stiff servo drive, published torque and measured speed limits

perception: none -- the object pose is given
base_command: scripted walk round the hinge with the door (BoxSite.base_pose_m), velocity commands from script.base_velocity_command: path rate fed forward, pose error fed back
